note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; each one names the published guides it draws on, and never copies their text. Five trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch: their guides say so honestly instead of inventing steps.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
EGamers — GTA 6 100% Completion: The Full Checklist

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing else is needed: no online play, no DLC, no difficulty setting. Expect around 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the first Chapter 1 mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end; it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1; it pops when the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it pops when you complete the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. Finish the final mission of the story. Free-roam carries on after the credits, so everything else on this list can be cleaned up afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run; it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist; it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play; it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners; it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown; it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory; it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Gold, and the hardest trophy on the list. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work through the checklist. It is lenient, closer to 60% of true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. But a few things are required in full: every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the four types however you like; flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up. Track them under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink a basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race), and a stunt. Check Progress, then Activities, to see what is left; most of them happen naturally while you play.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger easier, so do these before chasing that one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough for this trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in his fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. You must reach the end of a game; beating every challenge inside it is not required.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3, Andy calls Lucia and texts her an address in Belville. Complete her 5 quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 (green KR icon in Key Lento) after the mission Island Dreams. He marks treasure chests at 7 shipwrecks: dive to them, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. He disappears after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again in Chapter 2 to 3, so the line can be finished later. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Confirmed to count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). The questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. The trophy list's own counter shows your progress, and every strand stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also unlocks the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds, and cars delivered in good condition pay more. Still doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, Tyrone marks synthetic labs in purple around Vice City: destroy them (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest). Once enough labs are gone, his last job, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), awards the trophy. Available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen and walks out to the balcony. Follow her and accept. That meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason (Jason-only) and his first quest, Veteran Hunted, is in Lummox County. Hunt the animals he marks with purple icons and bring them back as Jason; he gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle in the first quest. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed, but the 100% checklist needs all 15 of his Target Decks anyway, so finish the line.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 480 cards across 18 sets; the Progress menu's Collections section shows how close each set is. You do not need all of them: the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone's WAiNK app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges; Progress, then Challenges, marks finished ones with a tick. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way: many complete themselves while you play, and you can pick the easiest ones left at the end.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs Jason and Lucia together, so only after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then escape until you are out of the red heat zone. A fast sports bike helps; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off the cops and the helicopter. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often pops there on its own.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back while staying wanted (flashing red and blue) the whole time: do not lose the wanted level between shops. Bring body armor, sticky bombs and healing. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) sit close together and work well; rob a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe. The pop can take about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not come, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1) and scan them: you only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so this comes automatically.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (click both sticks, L3 and R3, while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first: eat, drink, or wash up at home, and Adrenaline stretches it. Then line up 5 enemies and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Gang-operation thugs work; police, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Focus has 4 levels (raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots), so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA: it must be connected to a boarding bridge, and planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Easiest at gates E3 and E4: drive through an airfield fence, use the stairs and door by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport before it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County: the tanks stand at the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking it in trips the alarm), find the safe code on a note in the back room, and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City works well.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip into the vault while it is open, and get out. Bring your partner: the cash is too heavy for one person, so hand off a bag. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000. Rob any 5 of the 8 vaults (the 100% checklist needs all 8); every vault robbery gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch cars to go unrecognized.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults counts: robbing a vault counts as robbing the truck. Earlier, you can also box in an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back doors and blow them open, then escape the red heat zone (or reach a Pay 'n' Spray) before it pops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the whole map. Fastest by plane: fly over every dark patch until the map is fully visible.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total). They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically as the story goes on. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch (PowerPyx and GTABase, 18 November 2026). The description is the only hint: have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach. Try the bars and viewpoints along Ocean Beach in free roam and watch for the pop; this guide will be updated once a method is confirmed. Do not trust any step-by-step method you see elsewhere until a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch (PowerPyx and GTABase, 18 November 2026). The description points to smashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, which is the likely method, but it is unconfirmed. Try driving a car through a showroom's front window in free roam; this guide will be updated once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit: the robbery respawns after a long while, so you can come back for what is left.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time (Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength). Work out at fitness clubs: filter the map's Activities for them, and always bring your partner along (call them over). While one trains, the other trains too, so you progress twice as fast. After the story you can also train at home. Needs both characters, so only after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile: the trophy list's counter shows your progress (click the trophy in the list). Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications) to see each action register. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes and fights all count; it mostly happens on its own while you work on everything else. Avoid pushing into the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch (PowerPyx, 18 November 2026). 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt; PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is unconfirmed. Do not chase guesses: check back once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch (PowerPyx and GTABase, 18 November 2026). 'What the hell just happened?' points to a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida; PowerPyx believes it is from a UFO questline, but that is unconfirmed. It will most likely pop while exploring: do not chase guesses.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch (PowerPyx and GTABase, 18 November 2026). The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle, a melee drive-by; PowerPyx believes it is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but that is unconfirmed. Try melee attacks from a moving bike once a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total of $250,000, not one delivery, and the robberies for 100% get you there; a single bank vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it: there are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores and 11 tattoo studios to spend it in.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages for sale, about $160,000 in total. They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone: buy them through the app. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the cash, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 to 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, respray and register them there. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes), and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
